Respected Indians 🌻

Let's say you were going through some unwanted suffering and weren't allowed to get treated. How'd you feel? Women in India weren't give the right to Abortion and were forced to give birth to another human being whom they couldn't take care of or weren't prepared to nurture at all. Many people argued that it's the woman's fault but it isn't. There are various reasons behind unwanted pregnancy and we need to consider them. 

After several years of hustle, The supreme court of India has considered the Right to Abortion as a fundamental right of women. Finally, women in India can celebrate their body and their choice. 

Therefore, we bring to you *Marzi*, an initiative by *Sundarbans House* and *Sahityika : IITM BS Literary Society* where you can pen down your thoughts on Right to Abortion of Women in India. 

Submission starts on 4th November.
Submission ends on 11th November.

Your submission can be a write-up, paragraph, letter, poem or essay.

Submission must be in word format. 

Google form link for submission : https://forms.gle/NoANkMZiPBEXk8HB8

Make sure your submission speaks for the women in India. 

Put yourself in their shoes and then write your words for submission.

Regards,
Sundarbans House and Sahityika : IITM BS Literary Society

Hello @VIGHNESH MISHRA, 

Thank you for your enthusiasm. Sahityika is the Pan BS Literary Society and we dedicate ourselves to literature, reading, writing, and oration.
  
We've been conducting regular reading sessions, for more than a year now, where we read and dissect classics as well as work of modern fiction. So if you're a bibliophile, those sessions are going to be your sanctuary. 

Apart from this, we frequently conduct various literary events to provide a platform to the budding writers and speakers of the society. The latest events being Lafz-e-Tarksh and Marzi. Although majorly focusing on them, we tend not to limit ourselves to writing and oration - X Marks The Spot, the famous treasure hunt event being an example. 

This isn't all. We interact regularly with our members and maintain transparency. And we'd be glad if you join our reading sessions where we can talk to you and answer every specific query that you have in mind. We also have a WhatsApp group in case you were unaware of it. And if you require any further information, anything specific, please go ahead. 🙂

It is our pleasure to invite your esteemed institute to participate in the IIM Ahmedabad Parliamentary Debate scheduled to be held on campus from 26 to 28 January 2024. We have a stellar Core Adjudication Panel (consisting of Aayana Rai Bhojani, Angad Singh Chawla, Pranav Kagalkar and Sayantan Bhattacharyya), a sizable IA budget and accommodation on campus at IIM Ahmedabad. Further, we will be giving out cash prizes amounting to more than INR 110,000 (with prizes for semi-finalists, novice breaks, etc.).  

The event is happening alongside our annual cultural festival, Chaos, which gives all participants the opportunity to attend amazing concerts, sessions from prominent guest speakers (the likes of Shashi Tharoor), and a chance to participate in other informal events. 

We would request you to kindly register your teams and adjudicators by 7 January 2023 at https://linktr.ee/lsd.iima.

Thanks and Regards,

From the shadows of a cosmic rift, an enigmatic world materializes, and its revealer, the esteemed Dr. Oguro, bestows upon it the name *Remina*, a tribute to his beloved daughter. The revelation invokes both jubilation and dread, for Remina's celestial voyage accelerates, devouring celestial realms and extinguishing stars, leaving Earth teetering on the precipice of annihilation. Could the spectral specter of the girl Remina herself be the dread harbinger of this cataclysmic fate?

Behold a macabre masterpiece by the hand of *Junji Ito*, an epic tale unfurling upon a cosmic canvas.

*Hellstar Remina*
*Recap*

The tale begins with Dr Oguro, a renowned Astrophysicist from Japan, entertaining a gaggle of galloping reporters, on the day of announcement regarding their team's revolutionary discovery - a planet, which has all of a sudden come into existence by the grace of a newly discovered wormhole. Where did it arrive from, where does the wormhole open at the other end, nobody knows. Sitting with Dr Oguro is her teen daughter, Remina, who is somehow dealing with the fact that her father has decided to name the newly discovered planet after her. 

Soon, the news and its exaggerated permutations spread like locust and Remina becomes a star, an icon. Her stardom attains newfound peaks with an official fanclub coming into existence, as well as her becoming the brand ambassador of a construction company, owned by a shady tycoon with a shadier family.

But, this newfound fame is short lived, for in the grand scheme of things, in this infinite universe with infinite possibilities, Remina, the planet, starts moving towards our solar system, on a collision course! At the same time, scientists from Dr Oguro's team start losing their mind after constant observation of this rogue planet. 

Horror strikes harder when Remina reaches the solar system, and obliterates Neptune, Venus, Saturn, Jupiter, and in the end, the planet named after the Roman God of war, couldn't put any fight against this monstrous celestial object. And soon, earthlings come to the spine-chilling realisation - Remina is no planet. Planets don't eat other cosmic bodies. Remina, is an eldritch beast. 

This information leaks amongst the common folks, the population that strengthens the fabric of any nation., only for them to succumb to mass hysteria. A hysteria which makes them come to a lunatic conclusion - Dr Oguro and Remina are the beacons that have attracted the cosmic horror from its slumber in the darkness amongst stellar menagerie.

Dear @all the lovely members of Sahityika, 🥰

We hope 2024 is treating you well. As summer bids us farewell and a new academic term is about to commence, Sahityika, the Literary Society of IIT Madras BS Degree offers you an opportunity to join the team! 🥳👽

Sahityika is one of the oldest student communities in this degree and shall surely thrive forward with all the love and support of our members as well as the hard work of the council. Being a literary society, we celebrate the symbiotic relationship of everything related to literature - reading, writing and oration, irrespective of the boundaries of any particular language. We want all the bibliophiles, the book worms, the authors, the poets, the orators, the shayars, and the debaters of IIT Madras BS (DS and ES) to join us. It does not matter if you are a connoisseur or an amateur, as long as you are an enthusiast, you shall find your sanctuary in Sahityika! ❤

Having said that, it is obvious that Sahityika spans across a variety of activities comprehensively. Consequently, effective management of such an organisation demands substantial dedication, commitment, and collaboration. Hence, with the beginning of a new session, we are looking to meet some amazing people who can join our council and be a part of Sahityika in order to carry the legacy forward. 🏃🫵🏼

 The council is divided into five departments:

1. Execution and Management 👔
2. Editorial and Documentation 📃
3. Creative and Design 🎨
4. PR and Sponsorship 🗣
5. Technical 👩🏻‍💻

Each department is looking for a talented pool of dedicated and passionate people who will not only become the faces of Sahityika in upcoming years, but also take it forward with grandeur, grace, and as much love as the founders have for it, if not more, while keeping the pillars of literary enthusiasm intact! 🤗

Sahityika Recruitment Form: https://forms.gle/4yQVh1xNaHW62PRQ9 🔗

So what are you waiting for? Whether you are from the DS domain or the ES ensemble, hurry up and join our ranks with the swift of a tempest! 🌪🌀🐎

Today marks the *116th Birth Anniversary of _Rashtrakavi_ Ramdhari Singh Dinkar* - a pillar, helping _Hindi Sahitya_ reach new heights. *Date and Time*: 23rd September, 2024; 7 PM onwards
*Meeting Link*: https://meet.google.com/rpy-dfin-rrp

Come, join us - grace us with your presence and thoughts. Let's pay tribute to a poetry giant and literature that is timeless ❤

Warm Regards
Sahityika x Gir x Namdapha x Sundarbans
